source: Original SVG authored from BTS adult guideline CT descriptors; it is not copied from a patient case or source figure.
rights: RadYar-authored original educational graphic. No patient image or third-party figure reproduced.
clinicalUse: Non-diagnostic conceptual graphic, not to scale. It does not represent CT findings in an individual patient.
purpose: Show the internal bronchial lumen compared with the outer diameter of the accompanying pulmonary artery (with the schematic ratio drawn >1), and contrast normal tapering with persistent airway calibre near a pleural landmark.
